title: ntwanano lowu a wu rhamba ku onhaka
intro: Anakanya u tumbele ehansi ka lwangu rin’we ni nhlavutelo, kambe u hlawula vutshembeki lebyi hambaneke. Xifaniso lexi a xi hanya ekusuhi swinene ni ntiyiso ni vuprofeta, kambe xi hundzukele eka lava a va wu ala. Mhaka ya vona yi yima tanihi xilemukiso lexi tiyeke xa leswaku ku va ekusuhi ni ku lulama ntsena a swi nge ponisi moya-xiviri lowu xengaka ku tshemba.
clues: A ndzi tshama endlwini ya muprofeta loyi a hlawuriweke hi Allah.
A ndzi wu tiva ntiyiso lowu nuna wa mina a wu chumayelaka, hambiswiritano a ndzi wu pfumeli hakunene.
Ndzi xengile ku tshemba ka yena hi ku yima na vanhu lava a va ala ni ku va pfuna ku lwisana na yena.
Ndzi boxiwa etlhelo ka munghana wa vukati wa muprofeta un’wana loyi na yena a xengaka, tanihi xikombiso eka lava nga pfumeriki.
Mhaka ya mina yi hlamuseriwa eka Surah At-Tahrim tanihi xilemukiso xa leswaku vuxaka bya rixaka na vaprofeta a byi nyiki nsirhelelo.
Ndzi lovile na vadyohi loko Allah a lovisa vanhu va Lut, va siyiwile na lava va saleke.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: U xengile muprofeta hi ku pfuna lava nga pfumeriki ku lwisana na yena
Lahlela ricece enambyeni hi xirhundzu leswaku u ri ponisa
U lave leswaku ku akiwa rhole ra nsuku hi nkarhi lowu muprofeta a nga ri kona
U hehle mutirheli wo lulama hi ku endla swo biha kutani a n’wi pfalela ekhotsweni
U rhangele vuthu ra tindlopfu leswaku ri lovisa Kaaba
trial.answer: U xengile muprofeta hi ku pfuna lava nga pfumeriki ku lwisana na yena

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: U lovile na lava nga pfumeriki hambileswi a tekiweke hi muprofeta

U nyikiwe n’wana wa singita loko a dyuharile
outcome.answer: U lovile na lava nga pfumeriki hambileswi a tekiweke hi muprofeta

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
